proves.claim: With submit.composeOnRunner on, submit runs no main merge, compose or trunk merge and queues the unmerged head.

cli.io-submit-handoff-compose-on-runner..why: Without it, the command would still merge before the runner composes, doing the work twice.

proves.claim: With submit.composeOnRunner off, submit still merges main into the builder source as before.

cli.io-submit-handoff-compose-on-runner..why: Without it, a default-off setting could change every submit unnoticed.
